description: Initializes and exports ORM models related to the food delivery backend, consolidating various model classes imported from different modules.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: The declarative base class for ORM models.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user entity with roles for authentication and authorization.

classes.name: Restaurant
classes.description: Represents a restaurant entity with relevant details.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Represents a menu belonging to a restaurant.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Represents an individual item on a menu.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Represents an item within an order.

classes.name: DeliveryAssignment
classes.description: Represents assignment of a delivery to a delivery person.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Represents payment information for an order.

classes.name: TrackingEvent
classes.description: Represents an event for tracking delivery progress.
